```{r}

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Tumor group mapping
# --------------------------------------------------
tumor_group_map <- c(
  "Gyn"="UCEC.MSI", "Gyn"="UCEC.MSS", "Gyn"="OV", 
  "Squamous"="CESC","Squamous"="LUSC", "Squamous"="HNSC.HPVneg", "Squamous"="ESCA.SC","Squamous"="BLCA", 
  "Adeno" = "BRCA.pos","Adeno" = "BRCA.neg","Adeno" = "PRAD","Adeno" = "LUAD","Adeno" = "LIHC",
  "GI"="COADREAD.MSI", "GI"="COADREAD.MSS", "GI"="ESCA.AD", "GI"="STAD", "GI"="PAAD",
  "Kidney"="KICH", "Kidney"="KIRC", "Kidney"="KIRP",
  "NC-Derived"="GBM", "NC-Derived"="LGG", "NC-Derived"="SKCM", "NC-Derived"="UVM",
  "Other" = "ACC","Other" = "MESO","Other"="PCPG", "Other"="SARC", "Other"="TGCT", "Other"="UCS"
)

###########################################################################
###########################################################################
###                                                                     ###
###                              FIGURE 2C                              ###
###                                                                     ###
###########################################################################
###########################################################################
library(dplyr)
# ------- 2c.1 pan cacner level
arm_hit = read.csv("input/linear_regression_Outputs_armlvl.csv",row.names = 1)
arm_hit <- arm_hit %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  mutate(BH = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

arm_hit$hit_value = arm_hit$cnv_status * arm_hit$X.signedlog.P.adj.
arm_hit$hit_group = ifelse( arm_hit$hit_value > 0, "hot","cold")
arm_hit$EventType = ifelse(arm_hit$cnv_status > 0, "Gain","Loss")
arm_hit$tumor_group = unlist(sapply( arm_hit$TumorType, function(x){ res = names(tumor_group_map )[tumor_group_map  == x]
                                                                     if(length(res) == 0){res = "not in group"}
                                                                     return(res)}))   
arm_hit = arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group != "not in group",]


arm_hit = arm_hit[arm_hit$BH < 0.2, ]

arm_hit_all = arm_hit
arm_hit_all$panel = "ALL"
arm_hit_allexcept = arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group != "Kidney" ,]
arm_hit_allexcept$panel = "ALL except Kidney"
arm_hit_kidney = arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group == "Kidney" ,]
arm_hit_kidney$panel = "Kidney Only"

gg_df = rbind(arm_hit_all,arm_hit_allexcept,arm_hit_kidney)

legend_pos = c(0.85,0.85)
p2c = ggplot(gg_df,aes(x = hit_group,fill = EventType)) +
         geom_bar(position=position_dodge())+ 
         scale_fill_manual(values=c('#EA6A6A','#4F6DB8')) + 
         theme_classic() + 
         facet_wrap(.~panel) + 
         xlab("") + 
         ylab("Number of Arm SCNAs") +
         theme(  
                 axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
                 axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
                 strip.text = element_text(size = 20), 
                 legend.position = legend_pos,
                 legend.title = element_blank(),
                 legend.text = element_text(size = 18))

#pdf("/Users/ze/Desktop/Ze_figure_github/figure2/f2_c.pdf",height = 5,width = 10)
print(p2c)
#dev.off()
```
